errorCodes.meaning: `criterionId` does not name an Accepts criterion this community has stored.

EventStatus.description: How one stored event stands today. Counts only — never which members asked.

approved.description: Whether the stored event names an approver.

groupFloor.description: The smallest group this community will open the label for, as stored.

groupSize.description: How many members have asked to vet at this event through vtc/vetting/vetters/event-mode. The same count event-mode already returns to a vetter.

live.description: Derived: approved, groupSize at least groupFloor, and today no later than endDate plus graceDays.

EventStatus.title: EventStatus

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

PublishedConfig.description: The parameters exactly as they now appear in this community's join manifest, under vetting.ext. What an applicant and a vetter read.

helperKey.description: The helper verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for hvk.

tokenKey.description: The token verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for tvk.

vetterLabels.description: Class labels published whole, e.g. vetter/2026-09 — a request names one of these, not the bare period.

PublishedConfig.title: PublishedConfig

PublishedEvent.description: The published shape drops approvedBy and graceDays: who approved is the community's own record, and a vetter is told closesAfter when its request is approved rather than being handed the raw grace period here.
PublishedEvent.title: PublishedEvent

enabled.description: Whether the criterion carries hidden-vetting parameters. When false, stored, published, enrolledVetters and eventStatus are absent.

enrolledVetters.description: For each live class label (vetter/<period>), how many members hold an enrolment under it. Counts only.

eventStatus.description: One entry per stored event, in stored order.

requirementsDigest.description: The criterion's current requirementsDigest. Null only when its manifest entry carries none.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Show — response payload

StoredConfig.description: The parameters exactly as the community stores them, including the helper key it never publishes.

hvk.description: The helper verification key, multibase. A public value, published as helperKey.

livePeriods.description: Live vetter class periods, current first, stored as the bare YYYY-MM period.

suite.description: The blind-signature suite in force, e.g. ps-ddh-bls12381.

tvk.description: The token verification key, multibase. Never the same key as hvk.

StoredConfig.title: StoredConfig

approvedBy.description: Who approved the event, or null when nobody has. Recorded in storage only — dropped from the published shape (see published.events).

TickLength.description: The length of one tick of the drip, as an ISO 8601 duration in days and/or hours — at least `PT1H`. A label's tick `t` is the window starting `t` tick lengths after the label's start (`vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-tokens`).
TickLength.title: TickLength

dripPerTick.description: How many tokens a tick under this tier yields.

name.description: How the menu names it: desk, busy-desk.
